statement: The candidate model beats the baseline on the frozen holdout across the repeated seed set.
limitations: OOD evaluation was not performed; generalization beyond the synthetic generator's distribution is unknown.
Subgroup evaluation was not performed; per-segment behavior is unknown.
Calibration was not assessed; predicted-confidence reliability is unknown.
Drift was not assessed; stability under distribution shift over time is unknown.
non_entailments: A synthetic-data result does not entail real-data validity.
A repeated-seed mean does not entail stability under distribution shift.
